name: Material Design 3
summary: Google's open-source design system: 30+ documented UI components plus color, typography and layout guidance.
description: Material Design 3 is Google's open-source design system documentation. It covers over 30 UI components — buttons, cards, dialogs, lists, navigation, text fields and more — with usage and accessibility guidance, alongside style foundations such as color, typography and layout. 240+ documentation pages are browsable by component and by topic.
contains: per-component usage, anatomy and accessibility guidance
style foundations: color system, typography, layout
